SELECT DISTINCT t1.cd_username, t1.cd_pwd, t1.cd_key, t1.cd_code, t2.iccid FROM yz_card_route t1 LEFT JOIN yz_card_info t2 ON t1.cd_id = t2.channel_id WHERE t2.status_ShowId = '4' AND t2.agent_id = "1035" AND t1.cd_code = "YiDong_EC" AND t2.used IS NOT NULL AND t2.remaining IS NOT NULL AND syn_Time NOT LIKE CONCAT('%',#{systemDate},'%')

SELECT DISTINCT t1.cd_username, t1.cd_pwd, t1.cd_key, t1.cd_code, t2.iccid FROM yz_card_route t1 LEFT JOIN yz_card_info t2 ON t1.cd_id = t2.channel_id WHERE t2.status_ShowId = '4' AND t1.cd_code = "QMQW" AND t2.remaining NOT LIKE "%-%" AND t2.used IS NOT NULL AND t2.remaining IS NOT NULL AND t2.syn_Time NOT LIKE CONCAT('%',#{systemDate},'%')
SELECT DISTINCT t1.iccid, t2.end_time, t2.true_flow FROM yz_card_info t1 LEFT JOIN yz_card_flow t2 ON t1.iccid = t2.iccid WHERE t1.iccid = #{iccid} ORDER BY t2.end_time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT t1.cd_username, t1.cd_pwd, t1.cd_key, t1.cd_code, t2.iccid FROM yz_card_route t1 LEFT JOIN yz_card_info t2 ON t1.cd_id = t2.channel_id WHERE agent_id = "189" AND status_ShowId="4" AND t2.used IS NOT NULL AND t2.remaining IS NOT NULL AND t2.syn_Time NOT LIKE CONCAT('%',#{systemDate},'%')

SELECT DISTINCT t1.cd_username, t1.cd_pwd, t1.cd_key, t1.cd_code, t2.iccid FROM yz_card_route t1 LEFT JOIN yz_card_info t2 ON t1.cd_id = t2.channel_id WHERE agent_id = "1091" AND status_ShowId = "4" AND t2.used IS NOT NULL AND t2.remaining IS NOT NULL AND t2.syn_Time NOT LIKE CONCAT('%',#{systemDate},'%')

SELECT DISTINCT t1.cd_username, t1.cd_pwd, t1.cd_key, t1.cd_code, t2.iccid FROM yz_card_route t1 LEFT JOIN yz_card_info t2 ON t1.cd_id = t2.channel_id WHERE t2.agent_id IN ( 160, 871, 933, 968, 1095, 873, 876, 879, 1013 ) AND status_ShowId = "4" AND t1.cd_code="YiDong_EC" AND t2.used IS NOT NULL AND t2.remaining IS NOT NULL AND t2.syn_Time NOT LIKE CONCAT('%',#{systemDate},'%')

SELECT DISTINCT t1.cd_username, t1.cd_pwd, t1.cd_key, t1.cd_code, t2.iccid FROM yz_card_route t1 LEFT JOIN yz_card_info t2 ON t1.cd_id = t2.channel_id WHERE agent_id = "1355" AND status_ShowId = "4" AND t2.used IS NOT NULL AND t2.remaining IS NOT NULL AND t2.syn_Time NOT LIKE CONCAT('%',#{systemDate},'%')

SELECT t1.msisdn, t1.iccid, t1.imsi, t1.imei, t1.activate_date, t1.due_expire_time, t2.dept_name, t1.remarks, t1.used, t1.remaining, t1.status_ShowId, t3.packet_name, t1.network_type, t4.cd_alias, t4.cd_operator_type FROM yz_card_info t1 LEFT JOIN sys_dept t2 ON t1.dept_id = t2.dept_id LEFT JOIN yz_card_packet t3 ON t1.package_id = t3.package_id left join yz_card_route t4 on t1.channel_id= t4.cd_id
GROUP BY t1.iccid
SELECT true_flow FROM yz_card_flow WHERE iccid = #{iccid} ORDER BY create_time LIMIT 1
